name: Morganth
summary: Across Redridge, Theocritus watches Morganth hunt an ancient relic.

sections.title: A Watcher Across the Border
sections.body: From the Tower of Azora in eastern Elwynn Forest, Theocritus watches the crags of Redridge through his scrying spells. He sees Morganth, a warlock in the Tower of Ilgalar, searching for the Scythe of Elune. Fearing Morganth is close to claiming it, Theocritus asks Alliance champions to stop him before Stormwind is threatened.

sections.title: Storming the Spire
sections.body: The Tower of Ilgalar rises above the Redridge basin, where gnolls and twisted arcane energies fill its halls. Morganth waits at the summit, wielding shadow magic and guarding his research. To reach him, you climb through hostile ground and face the warlock directly. His Pendant of Shadow can be brought back as proof that the tower has fallen and the threat is broken.

sections.title: The Scythe's Lingering Shadow
sections.body: Morganth's defeat removes an immediate threat to Stormwind, but his search for the Scythe of Elune shows how far the artifact's dark legend reaches. Theocritus is relieved when he receives the Pendant of Shadow. The ancient scythe's whereabouts and the havoc it might bring remain unknown across the surrounding provinces.

faq.answer: Morganth is a powerful rogue warlock who lives at the summit of the Tower of Ilgalar in the Redridge Mountains. He studies the dark arts and seeks the Scythe of Elune, an artifact capable of wielding disastrous magic.

faq.q: Where is the Tower of Ilgalar?
faq.answer: The Tower of Ilgalar stands in the eastern Redridge Mountains, beyond Stonewatch Keep, with Shadowhide gnolls camped around its base.

faq.q: Why does Theocritus want Morganth dead?
faq.answer: Through scrying spells, Theocritus learned that Morganth was hunting the Scythe of Elune and feared he was close to finding it. The power Morganth sought threatened Redridge and the neighboring kingdom of Stormwind.

faq.q: What is the Scythe of Elune?
faq.answer: The Scythe of Elune is an artifact shrouded in mystery. Theocritus does not explain its powers, but fears that if Morganth finds it, Redridge and Stormwind will feel the warlock's dark might.

faq.q: What is the Pendant of Shadow?
faq.answer: The Pendant of Shadow is Morganth's magical talisman. It focuses his dark arts and, when brought to Theocritus at the Tower of Azora, proves Morganth has been defeated.

faq.q: What quest chain leads up to this?
faq.answer: The chain begins with 'Theocritus' Retrieval' in Elwynn Forest, followed by 'A Watchful Eye' and 'Looking Further'. Those steps recover tools and set up scrying to watch Morganth's tower. This is the chain's final part.

angles.text: As a mage, you see Theocritus's diligent, scholarly tradition: human mages watch from high towers to guard the realm from rogue spellcasters.
As a warlock, you see the danger of unchecked fel and shadow ambitions. Reaching for relics like the Scythe of Elune invites swift destruction.
As a night elf, whispers of the Scythe of Elune in human hands should alarm you. Its name touches sacred and volatile mysteries for the kaldorei.
As an Alliance member, you help protect Stormwind's exposed eastern borders. Defeating Morganth keeps Redridge from falling to dark sorcery.
